entities.name: Erpo Freiherr von Bodenhausen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erpo Freiherr von Bodenhausen was a German general who commanded the 12th Panzer Division during World War II. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany. Bodenhausen committed suicide on 9 May 1945 in the Courland Pocket.
